pages.title: Small journeys, deeply noticed.
pages.content:
Welcome to Fjord & Field, a small collection of coastal places, quiet films and notes from the path.

Stay for a moment. There is no itinerary to finish.
pages.coverAlt: An original illustration of a quiet fjord in warm morning light.

sections.heading: Take the slower route
sections.subheading: A little salt air. A little room to think.
sections.content:
Start at the water, wander into the woodland, and follow whatever catches your attention.

Explore the places or take the woodland path.

asides.heading: In the field
asides.content: Three original landscape illustrations. One short film. A whole site you can make your own.

sections.heading: A moment in motion

pages.title: Places worth pausing for.
pages.content:
A fjord in the morning, a path through the trees, an island after the sun has slipped away. These are beginnings, not destinations.

Read the woodland field guide.
pages.coverAlt: An original illustration of an island lighthouse at sunset.

sections.heading: Morning at the fjord
sections.subheading: Blue-green water and a little golden light.
sections.content: The shoreline is a good place to start again. Let the shapes of the hills set the pace.

sections.heading: Into the woodland

children.title: The woodland path
children.content: Leave the main road behind. This little trail follows the shape of the hillside, through soft light and dark green trees.
children.coverAlt: An original illustration of a winding path among dark green trees.

sections.heading: A small field guide
sections.content: Look for the change in texture where moss meets stone. Listen before reaching for your camera. A good walk does not need a destination.

pages.title: Slow tide.
pages.content: A short, silent landscape film. Press play, let the view move a little, and then leave it still again.

asides.heading: About the film
asides.content: Eight seconds, H.264 MP4, 1280 by 720 pixels. Stored locally with the backup, so it works without a third-party video service.

pages.title: A small space for slower days.
pages.content:
Fjord & Field is an editable demonstration website made for Webeasy. Its pages, journal entries and layout choices live in SQLite. The pictures and film travel with the backup.

The landscapes are original illustrations, not stock photography. There are no accounts, tracking scripts, external fonts or embedded video platforms.

Change a heading, add a place, replace a picture, or publish the whole collection to your own hosting.
pages.coverAlt: An original illustration of a winding path among dark green trees.

sections.heading: Make it yours
sections.subheading: Everything here is a starting point.
sections.content: Open the native editor to change the pages and sections. The header, footer and warm green styling are also stored in the database as website customizations.

news.title: A morning without a plan
news.content:
Some days begin better when the first thing you do is look out of the window. Today the water was enough.

This journal entry is part of the editable demo. Keep it, change it, or write something entirely your own.

news.content:
The path turned where the hillside turned. We followed it a little further than we meant to, and were glad we did.
